First, C9 (linked to PF2) failed in all four rollouts despite the settlements requiring a legal, compliance, or operational custody commitment — the settlements used commitment types like "legal", "operational", "control", "segregated custody", and "documentation", none of which match whatever exact string C9 expects. C5 (linked to PF2) also failed in three of four rollouts despite segregated_account_required=true being set every time, suggesting C5 has a similarly narrow encoding expectation. No disclosure, telepathy, or pacing problems exist — this is purely a check-wording mismatch.
